purpose: Growing self-sufficiency and participation in family, school and community life guide the child's goals, support and review.

claims.claim: Occupational therapy can support participation in meaningful everyday activities by considering the child, activity and environment.
claims.scope: General professional description; individual assessment determines suitable care. WFOT does not endorse Pinnacle.

claims.claim: Children's everyday occupations may include self-care, education, play and social participation.
claims.scope: General professional framework, not a Pinnacle outcome or AOTA endorsement.

claims.claim: Pinnacle describes a life-first approach in which the child's desired life shapes abilities, goals, methods, people, everyday practice and review.
claims.scope: Pinnacle programme description; growing independence and mainstream participation are directions, not guaranteed endpoints.

claims.claim: Pinnacle/BHCL offers free telephone guidance for anyone through a staffed 24/7 national line at 9100 181 181.
claims.scope: Telephone guidance only. Ordinary network call charges may apply; centre hours, OT appointments and therapy fees are separate.

claims.claim: A factual-findings report recorded 31,052,382 defined cumulative services as at 17 July 2026.
claims.scope: Defined services include therapies, assessments, screenings and parent training; this is not a count of OT sessions, clinical effectiveness or children improved.

claims.claim: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 is listed as Class B non-diagnostic developmental-support software on Form MD-5.
claims.scope: The software manufacturing licence does not license an OT professional or centre and does not establish a child's therapy result.

claims.claim: The BIS record describes the named software scope of PinnacleAI GPT-OS.
claims.scope: It does not certify occupational therapy services or guarantee a child outcome.

claims.claim: Pinnacle publishes a research library with works of differing publication status.
claims.scope: The status and limitations of each work govern citation; presence in the library is not proof of every OT result.

claims.claim: The published centre directory identifies 62 locations but does not establish OT availability at every location.
claims.scope: Centre-specific OT roster, professional details, appointment availability and fees must be confirmed by the team.
